# Worklogger

Repository: https://github.com/santiv343/worklogger
Assistant installation guide: https://github.com/santiv343/worklogger/blob/main/docs/assistant-guide.md
User guide: https://github.com/santiv343/worklogger/blob/main/docs/user-guide/README.md

Worklogger is a local MCP server for Jira and Bitbucket. Read the assistant
guide before helping a person install it. Never request, print, log, commit, or
place API tokens in shared files. Worklogger may persist them only in the
operating system's private secure store. Use the interactive installer when
configuration choices are not already known. Use the documented
`install --config ... --clients ... --yes` command only after the person has
reviewed the local configuration and selected the clients.
